decisions.observation: Avelin's finite transition contracts made abstraction behavior inspectable but left remedy communication and authority boundaries available for distinct work.
decisions.interpretation: Refinement and recourse can share a typed evidence envelope if their claim ceilings remain separate.
decisions.decision: Build abstract-recourse contracts that pair counterexample structure with remedy and disclosure vacancies.
decisions.evidence: 200 immediate-source reviews and 40,000 pairwise bounded comparisons
decisions.rollback: Quarantine any semantic collision and retain zero inherited credit.

decisions.observation: Scanner definitions can self-match if exact forbidden tokens appear literally.
decisions.interpretation: Candidate versus confirmed-hit adjudication must include the scanner definition byte domain.
decisions.decision: Construct sensitive route tokens from inert fragments and preserve the initial self-hit failure.
decisions.evidence: Retained PRE-N008 and recovered 92/92 plan validation
decisions.rollback: Stop the scan and retain candidates rather than declaring privacy clean.

decisions.observation: Thin public tools are safer when their claim surface is narrower than owner-phase executors.
decisions.interpretation: Promotion should consolidate intake, refusal and provenance without pretending to reproduce the full phase.
decisions.decision: Publish five standalone envelope runners with strict unknown-field refusal and authority=false input.
decisions.evidence: Candidate and installed hash parity plus self-tests
decisions.rollback: Reject non-identical collisions and leave promotion unexecuted.

decisions.observation: A structural positive can coexist with a represented, open or exact-gated disposition.
decisions.interpretation: Implementation correctness and evidentiary disposition are orthogonal.
decisions.decision: Preserve every frozen disposition after typed equality rather than promoting it.
decisions.rollback: Any mismatch becomes open_gap and blocks finalization.
